## User Preferences

### Description
The package handles the standard user-preferencs like audio, chat colours etc through the userPreferences item.

### Usage
You can access the interface with `import { userPreferences } from '@arcade-client/base-package';`

The following items are available:
- `userPreferences.sound`: boolean
- `userPreferences.music`: boolean
- `userPreferences.chatSize`: number
- `userPreferences.chatColour`: number
- `userPreferences.notifications`: boolean
- `userPreferences.oneHandedPlay`: number
- `userPreferences.swipeToBuy`: boolean
- `userPreferences.colourBlindMode`: boolean

With the following function to update 1 or more of the items when required:
- `update(partial: Partial<IAngularShellUserPreferencesEx>)`: void

#### Game Preferences
It supports adding game specific preferences through the Game Preferences utility:

Any additional GamePreferences should be defined in the GameConfig.GamePreferences passed to the engine in `engine.initialise()`.

There are then the following 2 functions to manage those preferences:
```ts
// name refers to the name defined in your GameConfig.
userPreferences.updateGamePref(name: string, value: userPref): void;
userPreferences.getGamePref<T>(name: string): T;
```

**Example use from Scratch**
```ts
// file main.ts
const gameConfig = {
    ...
    GamePreferences: { 'symbolAnimations': true },
    ...
}
engine.initialise(gameConfig, containerModule);
```
```ts
// some other project file

let currentValue = userPreferences.getGamePref('symbolAnimations');
userPreferences.updateGamePref('symbolAnimations', newValue);
```
